data.title: Too Hot for Hell ~ Kansas City's Legendary Haunted Attractions Concentrate 52nd Season Into 13 Nights

data.title: ETCAMAH® (camizestrant) in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor approved in the US for 1st-line advanced HR-positive breast cancer
data.description: In Wilmington, Delaware, AstraZeneca has announced that their drug ETCAMAH® (camizestrant) has been given approval in the US for use in conjunction with a cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) 4/6 inhibitor (abemaciclib, palbociclib, or ribociclib) for treating adult patients who have hormone receptor (HR)-positive, HER2-negative, locally advanced, or metastatic breast cancer. This approval is granted upon the detection of ESR1 mutation during aromatase inhibitor (AI) and CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy. The decision was based on a test authorized by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
